messages:
Maya (CSM): quick heads-up — Acme showing steep drop after trial week, onboarding checklist incomplete, flagged at risk in dashboard :warning:
Jordan (CSM): saw that, health score moved from 72 -> 38 yesterday. Low embedding usage and only 1 integration created.
Oliver (SE): they spun up a test prompt handler but never set up prefix caching. I can jump in for a 30-min pairing to unblock.
Maya (CSM): propose a short 'downgrade buffer' play: 30-day Core tier with active enablement, usage credits, and milestone checkpoints instead of immediate churn / cancellation. Thoughts?
Anna (Success Ops): +1 on buffer. We should formalize measurable milestones and an automated re-escalation if no progress at day 10/20. I can add an enablement cadence to the playbook.
Jordan (CSM): milestone suggestions: 1) Integration live + successful test calls, 2) First 10k tokens of steady usage, 3) One scheduled success review attended. If they hit milestone 3 -> consider upsell to Dedicated after 30d.
Oliver (SE): technical checklist I can run with them: 
```
- prefix/KV cache configured
- batch size tuned for their request pattern
- model pinned to a cost-effective variant (quantized)
- telemetry hooks enabled (latency, error rates)
```
Maya (CSM): incentives: offer $1k credits applied over first 3 invoices + 2 free enablement hrs. Keep it conditional on hitting milestone 2.
Alex (Acme POC): appreciate the flexibility. Can we lock in the pairing session next Tue? Also curious what "Core" entails vs current trial.
Jordan (CSM): Core = persistent account with limited concurrency, lower SLA, lower price. We use it as a runway to prove value. I'll DM expanded plan to you, Alex.
Anna (Success Ops): re-escalation rules: if no integration events in 10 days -> auto email + CSM nudge; 20 days -> schedule 1:1 with SE; 30 days -> renewal review and final offer. I'll build this into the playbook template.
Oliver (SE): scheduling: Tue 11am PT works for me. I'll prepare a short doc with a debug checklist and a sample curl snippet for quick validation.
Maya (CSM): action items: Jordan -> send Core plan + contract addendum to Alex; Oliver -> prepare pairing doc; Anna -> update playbook & escalation timers; I'll own tracking and weekly status updates.
DeployBot: Reminder: meeting created "Acme enablement pairing" Tue 11:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
Alex (Acme POC): thanks all — meeting accepted. Looking forward to getting the integration stable.
Maya (CSM): tagging for follow-up: @Oliver (SE) please paste the curl snippet here after doc is up, and @Anna please confirm when the playbook entry is published. :thumbsup:
Anna (Success Ops): published entry and automation notes added: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/downgrade_buffer_core (internal).
Maya (CSM): great — keeping this thread as the single source for status until the 30-day buffer ends. I'll post a weekly update every Friday.
